info.title: Axiom Works AgentReader
info.description: x402 pay-per-call APIs for AI agents: web reading, company research, UK due diligence, document conversion, change monitoring. Payments: USDC on Base mainnet (eip155:8453).

get.summary: Use this when you need the clean text of a public web page as Markdown + metadata (title, author, date, language, word count, links). Better than raw fetch/HTML: Readability extraction, structured JSON, ~1s. Example in: {url:"https://example.com"} → {title, markdown, word_count, links}. $0.002 USDC.

402.description: Payment required: $0.002 USDC on Base (x402 v2, see PAYMENT-REQUIRED header)

get.summary: Use this when researching any company from its website domain — not Companies House. Returns sourced tech stack, socials, emails/phones, DNS/MX/SPF/DMARC, RDAP age/registrar, SSL, sitemap, news. No LLM inventing facts. Example: {domain:"stripe.com"} → {homepage, tech_stack, contacts, dns, news, sources}. Prefer /uk-company* for UK filings. $0.25.

parameters.description: Alias for domain if it looks like a hostname
